    BO13a Lemma 5 a): the factorization propagation #

    Let μ be long and let the chain morphisms ρ (p+j), σ (p+j) (j < N) be non-long. Suppose two distinct arrows out of x p do not divide ρ p. A "state" at depth d is an object M with R : x (p+d+1) → M, S : M → z (p+d), T : M → E, σ (p+d) = R ≫ S, satisfying non-factoring conditions. Every state is contradictory (RayQuiver.MulBasis.lemma5a_propagation): either ρ (p+d) does not factor through S (BO13a figures 5.2, 5.3), or ρ (p+d) = R' ≫ S and then σ (p+d-1) does not factor through R' (figure 5.4), or we descend to a state at depth d − 1, or we reach x p (the D̃₅ case).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.lemma5a_caseA {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] (B : MulBasis k P A) (hmin : ∀ (I : TwoSidedIdeal A), I ≠ ⊥ → Statement.IsRepresentationFinite (A ⧸ TwoSidedIdeal.asIdeal I)) (hL : RayCat.LeftCancel P) (hR : RayCat.RightCancel P) {a b : P} {μ : a ⟶ b} (hμ : RayCat.IsLong μ) (Z : RayCat.ZChain P) (p L : ℕ) (hnρ : ∀ j ≤ L, ¬RayCat.IsLong (Z.ρ (p + j))) (hnσ : ∀ j ≤ L, ¬RayCat.IsLong (Z.σ (p + j))) (F : Fin 2 → RayCat.BMor (Z.x p)) (hFi : ∀ (i : Fin 2), IsIrreducible (F i).snd) (hF01 : F 0 ≠ F 1) (hFρ : ∀ (i : Fin 2), ¬∃ (g : (F i).fst ⟶ Z.z p), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (F i).snd g = Z.ρ p) (G : Fin 2 → RayCat.BMor (Z.x (p + L + 1))) (hGi : ∀ (i : Fin 2), IsIrreducible (G i).snd) (hG01 : G 0 ≠ G 1) (hGτ : ∀ (i : Fin 2), ∃ (t : (G i).fst ⟶ Z.z (p + L + 1)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (G i).snd t = Z.ρ (p + L + 1)) (hτμ : ¬FactorsThroughMorphism μ (Z.ρ (p + L + 1))) (hτr : ¬IsIrreducible (Z.ρ (p + L + 1))) :
    False

    BO13a Lemma 5 a), case τ = ρᵢ. Let μ be long, the chain morphisms ρ (p+j), σ (p+j) (j ≤ L) non-long, and τ = ρ (p+L+1) not divisible by μ and not irreducible. Let F be two distinct arrows out of x p not dividing ρ p, and G two distinct arrows out of x (p+L+1) each dividing τ. Then we get a contradiction.

    BO13a Lemma 5 a), entering the propagation at a source. A state at the source x (p+d): R' : x (p+d) → M, R : x (p+d+1) → M, S : M → z (p+d) with ρ (p+d) = R' ≫ S, σ (p+d) = R ≫ S, is contradictory, provided the chain morphisms before position p+d are non-long and ρ (p+d) too.
